current_text.html: There shall be a General Assembly Local Arrangements Committee, which shall function under the Administrative Committee. Final approval of all decisions regarding the Assembly shall rest in the Administrative Committee. The Assembly’s Administrative Committee and the Local Arrangements Committee shall operate under a Manual approved by the Administrative Committee.
